text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey. You know your whole workflow?
Yeah, I
restructured it. Just sent it over,
so take a look.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You have no idea how much time you've been wasting. At least try to be efficient.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Too much drive can blind you, you
know
that?
